candidate_law: Every finite registry is a candidate research seed; a count never establishes universal completeness or provider conformance.
compiler_flow: separate semantic, presentation and runtime state
emit result, state, freshness, loss and decision receipts
core_method_posture: Deterministic typed contracts, algebras, state machines and qualified runtimes; generative methods are outside the core.
decomposition: freshness, disclosure, reproducibility and decision handoff

identity_splits.law: encoding references but never owns metric, field, unit, time or aggregation meaning
rows/cells and selections/focus/viewports have separate identities and editions
a reusable surface does not replace question/evidence/decision provenance
immutable data cut and changing stream epoch never share one completeness claim
evaluation state and transport state advance independently
serialized bytes do not imply revocable continuing access
cells and stored outputs do not identify process, environment or current memory
equivalent structure/navigation is not inferred from color, theme or alt text alone
prose links inspectable support but is not proof
representation age and source correction posture remain independent

scope: Horizontal analytical consumption from semantic query intent to human decision handoff, independent of any UI application or vendor product.
unknown_law: Unknown owner, semantics, edition, authority, freshness, loss, accessibility or capability becomes a typed gap and fails closed.
